components.html:
Evidence panel

Interpretation remains adjacent to the supporting metric.

narrative.overview: A dark, high-density executive surface built to move from marketing claim to CRM evidence without changing tools. Warm ink supports long-form reading; controlled accents distinguish evidence type rather than decorate the page.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and definitions sit next to every consequential number.
Orange carries Align identity; teal carries verification and active-state meaning.
Tables are dense by design and paired with narrative interpretation.
Personal contact details stay out of the client-facing surface.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Accent color always carries meaning: brand emphasis, channel identity, confirmation, or caution.

rules.name: The Numbers Lead Rule
rules.body: Numerical values use strong weight and tabular alignment; their definitions remain adjacent and readable.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation through information priority; most containers use one border or one shadow, not both.

dos: Do distinguish native, recovered, and unresolved attribution in plain language.
Do keep explicit won revenue separate from open pipeline and unpriced opportunities.
Do provide a downloadable CSV beside the interactive ledger.
donts: Don't expose individual contact names, emails, phone numbers, or lost-deal detail.
Don't turn unknown deal amounts into modeled dollars.
Don't use color as the only indicator of deal or evidence state.
